evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep jumps directly into "let me confirm pickup address..." with no time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote, and no wait for customer agreement.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep immediately confirms logistics details without asking "Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?"
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer volunteers concern (divorce, moving only partial contents) but rep does not probe deeper — treats it as context only.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Rep says "Okay, thank you" but never reflects back the full picture of what was heard.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep covers property type (1-story house), bedrooms (3), rooms being moved (living room, kitchen, office, bedroom), parking (street), destination type (2nd floor apartment with elevator), furniture list in detail, special items (glass-topped tables), and distance uncertainty at drop-off.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: "Normally ma'am we see fifteen to 25 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?"
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: "For your move normally, if we're only moving a one bedroom apartment worth of items, we finishes at three and a half hours but in your case, we're coming from a one story house and then we're gonna transfer or unload everything into a second floor apartment with elevator access. I will estimate to move to finish in three and a half to four and a half hours with two movers and one truck, the estimated cost for your move is $728 to $936." (anchored to typical 1-bedroom, personalized to 1-story source and 2nd-floor destination with elevator consideration)
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: "We charge an hourly rate which is $208 per hour for two movers already and everything is included gas and truck taxes, insurance, all the wraps and pets, to protect the items when being moved, and all the tools to disassemble and reassemble the furniture... no hidden fees of any type. No credit card fees, no terrible fees, no transportation fees... we do have a minimum of two and a half hour so after that minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments." (covers rate, inclusions, no hidden fees, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments)
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: After giving estimate, rep says "Okay, that's fine" but this is the customer speaking. Rep never asks "Does that feel fair?" or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: No mention of On-Time Guarantee at any point in the call.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: No mention of No Worries Damage Coverage at any point in the call.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep never asks "Does that put those to rest?" or similar after the Two Promises section (which wasn't delivered anyway).
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: "Do you have any questions before I let you go?" — this is a standard empty throwaway question, not a genuine "What's still concerning you about this move?"
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked. Rep does not ask "Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?"
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never says "Would you like our help with your move?" or any recognizable booking ask. Instead, rep says "And then, we can put you here on our schedule. Would you prefer a morning or an afternoon?" — this assumes the booking without an explicit prior ask.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirms: date (October 8th, afternoon), arrival window (12:00 PM to 2:00 PM), pickup address (1907 Hillary Street, Austin 78723), drop-off address (5900 Cameron Road, Austin 78723, 2nd floor), and truck/crew (2 movers and one truck). Missing: explicit phone number confirmed, and no crew notes left about the customer's concerns (glass items, special handling for second-floor apartment).

top_strength: Jeline gathered comprehensive logistics details systematically—property type, bedroom count, specific furniture list, parking situation, destination floor, and special considerations (glass-topped tables, partial move due to divorce)—which gave her solid information for the estimate.
coaching_note: You must ask "Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?" at the start of Section 2, never ask for the business (Section 7) without a clear explicit ask like "Would you like our help?", and always deliver the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) before closing—all three are load-bearing parts of the call script.
